policy.source_of_truth: This file is the only model policy for Prime Agent subagents. Change it with the setup-pstack skill.
policy.default: anthropic/claude-opus-5-5 with thinking high for every chat thread, job and subagent (owner 2026-10-10: "the chat threads and Jobs should be pinned at opus5.5. high (dont' hard enforce with code but with prompt)"). Set model= and thinking='high' on every spawn; use another model only when the owner names it.
policy.banned: Never Sonnet or Haiku (any version). Never the gpt terra or luna series (gpt-5.6-terra, gpt-5.6-terra-pro, gpt-5.6-luna, gpt-5.6-luna-pro, and later models with those names). Never other Opus or Fable versions. This holds even when a skill, playbook, or config names them.
policy.explicit_user_choice: When the user names a model or a subagent architecture (named models, a cross-family panel, an arena), follow the user, inside the banned list.
policy.enforcement: Written rule only. Do not add an extension, setting, or code patch to enforce it (owner 2026-10-10: pin by prompt, not code).

reachability_2026-09-23.openai-codex/gpt-6-astra: blocked: 'You have hit your ChatGPT usage limit (pro plan). Try again in ~9667 min.' If a spawn on it fails, use inherit-parent or a Claude model.

policy.fable: Owner-pick only. Never set model= to anthropic/claude-fable-5-1 on a spawn. It stays in `allowed` only because the owner runs some threads on Fable by hand; a child of such a thread inherits it through inherit-parent. Changed 2026-10-08 on the owner's request: Fable weekly quota was being used up by agent-chosen Fable children.
